firstNightReminder: Wake up the Stargazer and either show a out-of-play Outsider token or signal a no and put them back to sleep.
name: Stargazer
ability: You start knowing 1 not-in-play Outsider.(Or that all are in play.)[-1 Outsider]
flavor: Despite the curfew, they found the night sky irresistible.

name: Treasurer
firstNightReminder: Show the Treasurer 2 Minion tokens, one which is in play and one which is not, or signal a no, then put them back to sleep.
ability: You start knowing two Minions; one that is in play and one that is not.(Or that zero are in play)
flavor: You don’t have to be an alchemist to turn ink into gold.

name: Serf
firstNightReminder: Wake up the serf and have them choose 5 characters on the script. Then show them 1 of their chosen characters and either a thumbs up or a thumbs down, indicating if it is in play or not.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Serf, show them 1 of their chosen characters and either a thumbs up or a thumbs down, indicating if it is in play or not.
ability: On your 1st night, choose 5 characters. Each night, learn 1 of your chosen characters and if it is in play.[+0/1 Outsider]
flavor: The primary crop of those who till the fields of tyrants is suspicion.

name: Rascal
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Rascal, show them a character type that corresponds to a player seated X steps away from them, skipping travelers.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Rascal, show them a character type that corresponds to a player seated X steps away from them, skipping travelers..
ability: Each night, you learn the character type of a player seated X steps away from you(skipping travelers), were X is the current night number.
flavor: I swear, if I get my hands on that little-

name: Cartwright
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Cartwright and have them choose another player, then put the Repaired reminder token on that player.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Cartwright and have them choose another player, then put the Repaired reminder token on that player.
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself); They are safe from Outsiders and Minions until dusk.
flavor: At the site of a broken cart, everyone’s an expert.

name: Chronicler
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Chronicler and indicate either 1, 2, 1&2 or 3, depending on which corresponds to the latest executee
ability: Each night* you learn the number(s) that corresponded to the latest executee; 1) Drunk/Poisoned 2) Outsider 3) Neither.
flavor: The best way to preserve history is with dramatic flair.

name: Shepherd
ability: Each day you may visit the Storyteller and choose a past Night Phase; learn one thing that happened during that night phase.
flavor: Freedom, fresh air and a whole herd of friends! I dare you to name someone luckier than me!

name: Herald
ability: Each day*, you may visit the storyteller to learn a true statement about the player you nominated yesterday.
flavor: Lord of the common folk, bringer of peace, grand speaker for the commune of spirits, conqueror of Leng & Hyboria, champion of the eternal duel…

name: Jeweler
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Jeweler and have them indicate if they want to use their ability. If they do, indicate 2 players that has at least 1 living evil player seated between them. Then put the Used token on the Jeweler.
otherNightReminder: If they don't have a Used reminder token on them, Wake up the Jeweler and have them indicate if they want to use their ability. If they do, indicate 2 players that has at least 1 living evil player seated between them. Then put the Used token on the Jeweler.
ability: Once per game, at night you may choose to learn 2 players which have at least 1 living, evil player seated between them on the shortest route.
flavor: Cut short of perfection.

name: Poet
firstNightReminder: Wake the Poet and signal that they may choose 3 players. If they do, note those players down with the ✒️ reminder tokens.
otherNightReminder: If the Poet has yet to choose any players, wake the Poet and signal that they may choose 3 players. If they do, note those players down with the ✒️ reminder tokens.
ability: Once per game, at night choose three other players. Each day you may privately ask the Storyteller for a true statement relating to the chosen players as a group.
flavor: In the hand of a poet, the quill cast spells that topple mountains, stirs the oceans and commands the hearts of mighties of monarchs. The tyrant is right to fear them.

name: Braggart
ability: Once per game during the day, publicly choose a player that has not been nominated today; until dawn, if they die, the player responsible for their death’s team loses the game.
flavor: As a specimen, yes, I’m intimidating!

name: Palace Guard
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Palace Guard and have them choose either clockwise or counter-clockwise. Then show them a token of a character seated closer to them in that direction than the other.
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Palace Guard and show them a character token of a character seated further in the initially chosen direction than the character shown last night.
ability: You start by choosing a direction, even if drunk or poisoned. Each night, learn a character of a player further in that direction than last night's character.
flavor: It doesn’t matter how well armed you are if you’re not also prepared to leg it.

name: Ratcatcher
ability: Outsiders you nominate are drunk until dawn, and stay drunk from now on if executed. Executed Outsiders learn who you are. [+1 Outsider]
flavor: Hello Mister Rat! Have you met my friend, Mister Key?

name: Stalker
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Stalker and have them choose a player; put a Stalked reminder token on that player.
otherNightReminder: Remove any Stalked reminder tokens from players. Wake up the Stalker and have them choose a player; put a Stalked reminder token on that player.
ability: Each night, choose another, living player; reminder tokens that would be placed on that player tonight might be placed on you instead. [-1/+0/+1 Outsider]
flavor: Hello? Is anybody there?

name: Lamplighter
otherNightReminder: If the Lamplighter nominated today, wake up each evil player in any order and have them choose a player; they learn the player they chose's character.
ability: Each night*, if you nominated today, 1 or more evil players chooses a player; they learn the chosen players’ character.
flavor: Someone must be first to wait , alone in the dark.

name: Quack
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Quack and have them choose clockwise or counter-clockwise. Put the Drunk reminder token on the closest good player seated in the chosen direction.
otherNightReminder: If alive, move the Drunk reminder token to the next good player seated in the chosen direction.
ability: You start choosing a direction; your closest good neighbor in that direction is Drunk, even if dead. Each night*, the drunkenness moves to the next good player in the chosen direction.
flavor: Refund? Never heard of him.

name: Hellion
ability: One more vote is secretly needed to mark players for execution. You keep this ability when killed by the demon.
flavor: A striking addition to any social occasion.

name: Maggot
ability: You start knowing 3 in-play Townsfolk characters. Choose 1; they are poisoned.
flavor: The early worm eats the bird.

name: Troglodyte
ability: You start knowing one not-in-play Outsider, and if you have their ability. You might register as an Outsider.
flavor: Feeding on a diet of cave slime and fungi, sometimes these vile critters make their way up from the pools of stagnant waters far below the catacombs.

name: Wight
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Wight and have them choose a player. Put the Haunted reminder token on the chosen player.
otherNightReminder: If the player with the Haunted reminder token on them was executed yesterday and; if the Wight is alive, put the Dead reminder token on a living player or; if the Wight is dead, put the Returned reminder token on the Wight.
ability: On your 1st night, choose a living player (not yourself); When they are executed, you are resurrected the following dawn. If you cannot be resurrected, a player dies instead.
flavor: Rust and mold are not shackles that will hold the vengeful spirit.

name: Chindi
ability: When you learn that you have died you may publicly choose 3 living players; 1 becomes Evil tonight.
flavor: Please, who will write my eulogy? Who will cry and whisper my name, as my ashes spread over the meadow? Someone, remember me.

name: Carnificina
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Carnificina and have them choose 3 living players. Put a Prey token on each of those players. Put the Aware token on one of those players and wake them up. Show them Carnificina token and the 2 other chosen players.
otherNightReminder: If all players with Prey tokens on them live, put a Dead token on 2 of them. If at least 1 of the players with a Prey token on them is dead, instead put a Dead token on any living player. Then remove all Prey tokens. Wake up the Carnificina and have them choose 3 living players. Put a Prey token on each of those players. Put the Aware token on one of those players and wake them up. Show them Carnificina token and the 2 other chosen players.
ability: Each night, choose 3 living players: One learns the rest. Next night, if all live, two die. Otherwise, a player dies.
flavor: Hunger.

name: Bastantes
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Bastantes and have them choose a player. Put the Dead reminder token on that player. Then you may wake another player and show them a prepared text with the Devil's Bargain you wish to offer them.
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. Then, a dead player might be offered a Devil’s Bargain. A Devil’s Bargain must be accepted publicly during the day.

name: Miasmagus
otherNightReminder: Wake up the Miasmagus and have them choose a player. Put the Dead reminder token on the chosen player. Then, if that player is an Outsider, put the Poisoned reminder token on a Townsfolk player
ability: Each night*, choose a player; they die. When you kill an Outsider, 1 player is poisoned until an Outsider dies.[+1 Outsider or; an Outsider might be duplicated]
flavor: The sweet and intoxicating scent of putrefaction seems especially heavy in the labyrinth.

name: Peregrimor
firstNightReminder: Wake up the Peregrimor and show them each player that is an Outsider. Then wake up each evil Outsider in turn and show them the player that is the Peregrimor.
ability: You know all Outsiders. Evil Outsiders learn who you are. Each night* choose a player; they die. [+1 Minion, All Minions are Evil Outsiders. They might be duplicates.]
flavor: Friends. Strangers. Family. Traitors. Where we’ve ended up, they’re all the same.

name: Dealbreaker
firstNightReminder: Have the Dealbreaker indicate 1 or 2. If they indicate 1, indicate a drunk/poisoned player or indicate a no if there are none. If they indicate a 2, show them a out-of-play character token.
otherNightReminder: Have the Dealbreaker indicate 1 or 2. If they indicate 1, indicate a drunk/poisoned player or indicate a no if there are none. If they indicate a 2, show them a out-of-play character token.
ability: Each night you may choose to learn either 1) a player that is drunk/poisoned OR; 2) a character that is not in play.
flavor: You only had to choose; freedom or life? For your greed you shall have neither.

name: Tomb Prospector
otherNightReminder: Have the Tomb Prospector choose a player they believe to be alive. Then, if that player is alive, wake them up and indicate a dead player and give them a true statement about that player
ability: Each night*, choose another player; If alive they learn a true statement about a dead player.
flavor: Don’t go that way! Never go that way!

name: Lost Soul
otherNightReminder: Have the Lost Soul choose a player; publicly announce the player and character.
ability: Each night* you may choose a player (not yourself); their character is announced. If you choose an Evil player the character announced is arbitrary.
flavor: Any company is better than to wander the dark alone.

name: Torchbearer
ability: Each night, choose 2 players (not yourself); 1 learns a true statement, the other learns a false statement.
flavor: The way is lit. The path is clear. We require only the strength to follow it.

name: Scryer
firstNightReminder: Somehow obscure 3/4ths of the Grimoire, then show it to the Scryer.
ability: On your 1st night you see a quarter of the Grimoire.
flavor: The tyrant’s favor is fickle.
